_doc: Ingestion-format set (S-6, FR-2.1/2.2). The SAME logical model is delivered six ways; every ingestion path must resolve to the one logical model below. Text variants (paste/single/multi) are committed; binary variants (zip/docx/pdf) are materialized by tests/tools/build_corpus.py. The PDF is intentionally LOSSY (carries only a code fragment) so ingestion must raise a lossy-extraction Issue.
